data.description: Search for photos based on time data
data.descriptionEn: Search for photos based on time data
data.descriptionZh: 基于照片时间数据搜索
data.readme:
· Organize photos into a timeline by year, month, location, person, or theme.
· Support viewing shooting info like recording time, location, device, and format
· If information is incomplete, indicates which results cannot be determined for now
data.readmeEn:
· Organize photos into a timeline by year, month, location, person, or theme.
· Support viewing shooting info like recording time, location, device, and format
· If information is incomplete, indicates which results cannot be determined for now
data.readmeZh:
· 可以把照片按年份、月份、地点、人物或主题整理成时间线
· 支持查看照片的拍摄时间、地点、设备和格式等拍摄信息
· 如果信息不完整，会说明哪些结果暂时无法判断
